data_offset_agreement.method: anchored: compare mapped annotated offsets within each original evidence range and PE section; uncertain ownership omitted

link_order_list.method: list order versus original unit starts and legacy median-address keys; tail omitted

object_map.method: first public .text symbol per map object; objects without public symbols omitted

size_exact_prefix.method: all original functions mapped with equal code sizes; bytes use original unit spans

unit_contiguity.method: one run of mapped functions in original function order; unmapped functions omitted; mapped annotations inside a unit range that start no listed function count with that unit

unit_order_inversions.method: median mapped function address per unit; ties are not inversions

unit_relative_identity.method: whole function byte identity; image-address operands and external relative branches masked; missing functions count against original bytes
